query: Saw a car slow down and come to a complete stop.
Somebody lowers whatever they were holding and sets it down next to them, letting go of it.
A car driving along slows down, swings round to the right and carries on that way.
Somebody walks up to a parked car, grabs the handle and swings the door open.
A grey-haired man wheeling a black metal cart across the gym.
Person in a white top standing by the small white building across the lawn, seemed to be on the phone.
A guy in a dark beanie putting a cup down on the drinks table.
A bald man in dark clothes standing in the middle of the seated group near the bleachers, chatting with someone in a checked shirt.
Somebody hands something over to another person in the crowd.
A man in a dark top sitting at the long table in front of the bleachers, busy with what looked like a laptop, with someone next to him.
An SUV starts moving and drives off to the left along the road by the walkway.

A car pulling away on the far road.
